title: Data Loading and Storage
summary: This module provides components for loading data from external sources like LangSmith and storing it in vector databases, including in-memory and Qdrant implementations. It facilitates the creation and management of vector indexes for efficient similarity search.

nodes.label: Load LangSmith Examples
nodes.title: LangSmith Data Loader
nodes.description: Fetches dataset examples from the LangSmith platform, converting them into structured Document objects for further processing.

nodes.label: In-Memory Vector Store
nodes.title: In-Memory Vector Database
nodes.description: Manages and searches vector embeddings in memory, providing fast similarity lookups for retrieved documents.

nodes.label: Qdrant Vector Store (New API)
nodes.title: Qdrant Vector Database (New API)
nodes.description: Integrates with the Qdrant vector database, supporting advanced vector search capabilities including dense, sparse, and hybrid retrieval.

nodes.label: Qdrant Vector Store (Classic API)
nodes.title: Qdrant Vector Database (Classic API)
nodes.description: Provides an interface for storing and querying vector embeddings in a Qdrant instance, offering both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

nodes.label: Create Vector Store Index
nodes.title: Vector Store Index Creator
nodes.description: Automates the process of building a vector index from raw data, involving document loading, text splitting, and embedding generation.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.title: Document Object
nodes.description: A fundamental data structure representing a piece of content, typically text, along with associated metadata.

nodes.label: Embeddings
nodes.title: Embedding Model
nodes.description: A model or function that transforms text into numerical vector representations, capturing semantic meaning.

nodes.label: Sparse Embeddings
nodes.title: Sparse Embedding Model
nodes.description: A model or function generating sparse vector representations, often used in conjunction with dense embeddings for hybrid search.

nodes.label: Text Splitter
nodes.title: Text Chunking Utility
nodes.description: A utility responsible for breaking down large documents into smaller, overlapping or non-overlapping chunks suitable for embedding and indexing.

nodes.label: LangSmith Platform
nodes.title: LangSmith Platform API
nodes.description: The external platform providing datasets and examples for evaluation and development.

nodes.label: Qdrant Client
nodes.title: Qdrant Database Client
nodes.description: The client library used to connect and interact with a Qdrant vector database instance.
